Build With AI: Basics

Welcome to our learning hackathon. The hackathon begins September 15, 2026 and runs for six weeks of building.

Submissions close October 26, 2026 at 5:00pm ET. Judging ends November 2, 2026 and winners are announced November 9, 2026.

Prizes

$2,500 in prizes overall. The grand prize winner receives $1,000 cash, with $500 for each of three runners-up.
